newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian UBCI bank distributes dividends.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian UBCI bank distributes dividends.

text.p: Tunisia's Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie UBCI said it started on Monday distributing a 0.75 dinar or 15 percent dividend per share on its results for 1996.
Net profits for 1996 were 26.20 million dinars, up from 18.54 million.
Turnover in 1996 was 76.16 million dinars and balance sheet 748.39 million dinars.
The bank's capital and reserves totalled 96.23 million dinars at end of 1996.
BNP Intercontinentale is among UBCI's main shareholders. ($=1.095 dinar)
